show.description: When a powerful tycoon freezes his sons’ fortunes, calm and principled Prithvi chooses dignity and hard work while his jealous brother Harsh chooses revenge. A contract marriage with fiery CEO Ragini pulls Prithvi into a web of corporate sabotage, betrayal, and a deadly conspiracy. As poison, greed, and attempted murder shatter the Diwaan empire, Prithvi must rise from ruin to expose the truth. But in the battle for legacy and love, who will truly win his heart? Watch now.
